name: Homura no Matsuri
source:
Freelance writer Kengo Sakuraba visits a lonesome hot spring town. The four sisters who manage the inn welcome him warmly. However, there is something strange in this town. What exactly is hidden there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
自由撰稿人樱叶健吾造访了一个偏僻的温泉小镇。经营旅馆的四姐妹热情地接待了他。然而，这个小镇有些不对劲。那里究竟隐藏着什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
